model_annotation: This plot illustrates the change in "Missing Step" values as a function of the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled "step" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Missing Step" and uses a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.860 to 0.845. A blue, dashed line with triangular markers represents the "0-CoT" data, starting at 0.860 at x=0 and declining to 0.846 at x=4. An orange, solid line with triangular markers represents the "CoRe" data, starting at 0.852 at x=0 and rising to 0.848 at x=4.
